title: Config system overhaul: move to ~/.config/shooter/nvim/, add YAML config, new commands

New commands: ShooterCfgReload, ShooterCfgEditGlobal, ShooterCfgEditLocal. Auto-reload on config save. Day marker color and debounce configurable via YAML.
close_reason: Created ext_config.lua with YAML parser/serializer, path accessors, migration, caching. Updated 6 modules (session/storage, filter_state, core/files, tmux/operations, core/templates, config) to use centralized path accessors. Added ShooterCfgReload, ShooterCfgEditGlobal, ShooterCfgEditLocal commands. Added auto-reload on BufWritePost of config.yaml. Added reapply_all() to syntax.lua. Day marker color and debounce now configurable via YAML. Updated help, docs. Added tests/core/ext_config_spec.lua. All files pass luac syntax check.

title: Fix BufEnter auto-fix causing W12 warnings and file conflicts
description: Shot 5 (cfg): BufEnter autocmd for config.yaml writes to disk then edit\!, causing W12 warnings and 'file changed since reading' prompts. Fix: update buffer lines directly via nvim_buf_set_lines instead of disk write, run only once per buffer.
close_reason: Fixed BufEnter auto-fix causing W12 warnings. Root cause: fix_config() wrote to disk while buffer was open, causing Neovim file-changed-externally warnings. Fix: added fix_config_buffer() that updates buffer lines directly via nvim_buf_set_lines (no disk write). BufEnter now runs once per buffer (tracked set). ShooterCfgFix command also uses buffer-based approach. Key files: lua/shooter/core/ext_config.lua, lua/shooter/syntax.lua, lua/shooter/commands.lua.

title: Optimize syntax highlighting performance + day marker toggle
description: Shot 53: Big shotfiles are slow when typing — text not appearing for a second. Root cause: O(n²) is_in_code_block() called per-line on every keystroke via TextChangedI. Fix: (1) O(n) precomputed code block map, (2) merged two loops into one, (3) 300ms debounce on TextChanged/TextChangedI, (4) day markers disabled by default, (5) ShooterFileToggleFirstShotOfDayColoring command + fcf keymap.
close_reason: Fixed O(n²) syntax highlighting in syntax.lua: replaced per-line is_in_code_block() with single O(n) build_code_block_map(), merged two loops, added 300ms debounce for TextChanged/TextChangedI, disabled day markers by default. Added ShooterFileToggleFirstShotOfDayColoring command in commands.lua and fcf keymap in keymaps.lua. Key files: lua/shooter/syntax.lua, lua/shooter/commands.lua, lua/shooter/keymaps.lua.

title: Day marker highlighting for executed shots

close_reason: Added ShooterDayMarker highlight group (#e6d5b8 light brown) applied to first executed shot of each date. File: lua/shooter/syntax.lua. Configurable via highlight.day_marker in setup().

title: Fix day marker coloring: mark first sent shot, not last
description: Shot 56: Day marker was coloring the last sent shot of each day (first occurrence top-to-bottom) instead of the first sent shot (last occurrence top-to-bottom, earliest timestamp). Fixed by tracking last line per date in seen_days, then building day_first_lines after the loop.
close_reason: Fixed day marker logic in syntax.lua: track last occurrence of each date (earliest shot of the day) instead of first occurrence (latest shot). Key files: lua/shooter/syntax.lua.

title: Fix multi-shot send from telescope picker
close_reason: Removed vim.schedule wrapper from send_multiple_shots in telescope/actions.lua. The deferred execution caused silent failures — any error inside the callback was swallowed. Now multi-send follows the same synchronous pattern as the working single-shot send_shot function.

title: Enable day markers by default + increase debounce to 1000ms

close_reason: Set day_marker_enabled=true and debounce from 300ms to 1000ms in lua/shooter/syntax.lua.

title: Fix ShooterLast: track last shotfile via Neovim, not filesystem mtime
description: Shot 19: ShooterLast unreliably opens the last edited shotfile because it uses ls -t (filesystem mtime) which gets updated by git operations, bd sync, etc. Fix: track the last shotfile the user actually opened in Neovim via BufEnter autocmd, persist to ~/.config/shooter.nvim/ for restart survival, fall back to ls -t only on first use.
close_reason: Added track_last_shotfile() to files.lua with in-memory + persisted state (~/.config/shooter.nvim/last-shotfile-<slug>). Hooked into BufEnter autocmd in syntax.lua. find_last_file() now checks tracked path first, persisted second, ls -t fallback. Key files: lua/shooter/core/files.lua, lua/shooter/syntax.lua.

title: Codebase Concerns
description: Technical debt and issues discovered by map-codebase. Auto-populated from CONCERNS.md analysis.

title: Shell injection risk in path string concatenation
description: Multiple locations use unquoted path variables in shell commands via io.popen(). Files: inbox/init.lua, repos.lua, helpers.lua, data.lua, project.lua, health.lua. Fix: Use vim.fn.shellescape() consistently (pattern exists in token_counter.lua).

title: Unchecked shell command failures
description: Many shell commands via io.popen() redirect stderr to /dev/null silently. Files: utils.lua, health.lua, send.lua. Fix: Check vim.v.shell_error after systemlist() calls, return error tuples from io.popen() functions.

title: Missing error handling in file operations
description: File read/write operations check if not file but assume all other operations succeed. Files: utils.lua, analytics/data.lua, health/tools.lua. Fix: Return error tuples from all I/O functions, propagate to command handlers.

title: Fragile timestamp-based response viewer lookups
description: Response viewer uses timestamp parsing from shot headers to find temp files. Old shots without @ref fall back to regex parsing. Fix: Always generate @ref in shot headers, deprecate timestamp fallback.

title: Tight coupling between tmux and vim operations
description: Tmux operations deeply integrated throughout plugin. No graceful degradation without tmux. Files: shot_actions.lua, wrapper.lua, send.lua. Fix: Create tmux abstraction layer that fails fast with clear errors.

title: vim-i3wm-tmux-navigator dependency
description: Niche plugin marked as required in health.lua but may be abandoned. Fix: Make optional, detect presence, provide fallback for non-navigator systems.

title: External script paths not validated
description: wrapper.lua runs scripts by name (d-tmux-edit-vim, d-tmux-lightswitch) without validation. Hardcoded ~/dev/scripts paths. Fix: Make configurable, validate at startup, return clear errors.

title: Untested critical paths
description: No tests for: shell injection prevention, response viewer edge cases, tmux send-keys with special chars, config merging, analytics with malformed headers. Fix: Add targeted test suites for each.
